info.name: Loon CADC Transparency Attestations Issuances API
List CADC issuance (mint) events for a chain

params.name: chainId
params.description: EVM chain id (e.g. 1 Ethereum, 8453 Base, 137 Polygon, 42161 Arbitrum, 59144 Linea).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of issuance events to return.

items.docs: Returns recent on-chain CADC mint events for a single chain, newest first. The chainId query parameter is required.
